newsitem.title: UK: Bank of Scotland gains market share.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Scotland gains market share.

text.p: Bank of Scotland said on Wednesday it continued to gain market share in Britain and added that the picture in most of its markets remained bright.

The bank's first half pre-tax profits rose 24 percent to 324.3 million pounds ($507.7 million) against analysts forecast range of between 283 and 305 million pounds. The dividend was raised to 2.91 pence per share from 2.45.

Stripping out the effects of last year's one-off 23.6 million pound gain from the sale of its 50 percent stake in Halifax Credit Card, and this year's inclusion of Bank of Western Australia, the underlying rise was also 24 percent.
"These results were achieved against generally benign economic conditions in the UK and USA with slightly more difficult conditions in Australia and New Zealand," Bank of Scotland said.
With a cost-to-income ratio of 52.9 percent the bank said it was more efficient than many of its competitors despite continuing high investment levels.
Shares in Bank of Scotland rose 9-1/2 pence to 265 in early trading. ($1=.6387 Pound)
